case.summary: A signed order for 500 LeanIX user licenses. At confirmation two tracks start in parallel: the commercial one (credit, billing, revenue) and the technical one (tenant, access, licenses).

lines: Quote Q-2026-5521 for Kestrel Versicherung AG
LeanIX Enterprise Architecture, 500 user licenses, term 36 months from 01.12.2026
List price 42.00 EUR per user per month, discount 10% approved by Sales Director, net 37.80 EUR
Onboarding workshop (2 days): 8,000.00 EUR fixed, one-time. Billing: annually in advance
Order form OF-7731, Kestrel Versicherung AG, signed 04.11.2026
500 user licenses LeanIX Enterprise Architecture, 37.80 EUR per user per month, 36 months
Subscription start 01.12.2026. Invoice annually in advance.
Customer data is hosted in the EU region only.
Single sign-on with the customer's identity provider is required.
Subject: OF-7731 - invoicing and access
Please send all invoices to Kestrel Group Services GmbH, Mainzer Str. 12, 60311 Frankfurt.
Our admins are Anna Brandt and Jonas Weiss. Please set up access before 01.12.
Credit check Kestrel Versicherung AG (100871)
Credit limit 200,000.00 EUR, open items 0.00 EUR
Exposure above the limit needs the credit manager.
Licenses are activated only after the credit decision. The tenant may be prepared before.
Template standard-tenant
Region: us-east (default)
Allowed regions: eu-central, eu-west, us-east
Set the region from the order form before the tenant is created.

findings.text: The order matches the quote: 500 licenses, 37.80 EUR per user and month, 36 months.
The 10% discount is already approved by the Sales Director, so the order needs no new discount approval.
The customer wants all invoices sent to Kestrel Group Services GmbH. The order in S/4 still has the sold-to party as bill-to.
Data must stay in the EU, but the standard tenant template defaults to us-east. The region has to be set before the tenant is created.
First year plus onboarding is above the credit limit. Licenses are activated only after the credit manager has decided; the tenant can be prepared in the meantime.

checks.needle: activated only after the credit decision

findings.text: The subscription is earned over the 36 months. The onboarding workshop is a separate obligation and is recognised when it is done. Revenue accounting should confirm this.

questions.q: What did Kestrel order and what is it worth?

calls.result: item 10: 500 user x 37.80 EUR, 36 months; item 20: onboarding 8,000.00 EUR

answer: 500 LeanIX user licenses for 36 months at 37.80 EUR per user and month (proof: O1 line 2). That is 18,900.00 EUR per month, 226,800.00 EUR per year and 680,400.00 EUR for the term.
With the onboarding workshop (8,000.00 EUR, Q1 line 4) the contract is worth 688,400.00 EUR.

questions.q: Why can the licenses not be activated yet?
answer: First year (226,800.00 EUR) plus onboarding (8,000.00 EUR) is 234,800.00 EUR and the credit limit is 200,000.00 EUR (proof: E2 lines 2 and 4).
Licenses wait for the credit manager. The clerk's limit is 50,000.00 EUR, so Tobias Krämer has to decide. The tenant and the single sign-on can be prepared in parallel.

questions.q: How much revenue is recognised by 31 December 2026?
answer: Billed: 226,800.00 EUR (first annual invoice). Recognised: 18,900.00 EUR, one month of 36. Deferred: 207,900.00 EUR.
Billing and revenue are different numbers. The invoice is a claim on the customer, revenue follows the service over the term. The split of the onboarding workshop is an inference to be confirmed.

questions.q: In which region should the tenant be created?

calls.result: region us-east (default); allowed eu-central, eu-west, us-east

answer: In eu-central. The order form says the data is hosted in the EU region only (proof: O1 line 4), and the template default is us-east (proof: W1 line 2).
The step to create the tenant sets the region from the order form. A region outside the EU is blocked by the same rule.
